Instructions.purpose: This workbook is a formula-only, multi-project HSE Management System aligned with common ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management-system practice. Projects are rows in Project Register, not separate sheets; dashboards and dropdowns read from those rows.
legend: Caution / expiring soon / in progress / conditional pass
howto: 1. Open Project Register and add one new row with Project Code, Project Name and core details.
2. Save the workbook. Project dropdowns, dashboard selectors and formulas reference Project Register automatically.
3. Add Manpower Log, incidents, actions, inspections and other records against the new Project Code. No sheet duplication is needed.
Instructions.switcher: Project Dashboard switcher: use the highlighted dropdown at the top of Project Dashboard. Excel 365/2021 dynamic functions used include XLOOKUP, FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, TEXTJOIN, IFS, MAXIFS, MINIFS, VSTACK and EOMONTH.
Instructions.admin: Sheet protection password: HSE2026. This is standard Excel accidental-edit protection, not encryption. Assumptions applied: 5x5 risk matrix, RateBase 1,000,000, 30-day expiry warning, weekly scaffold inspection, monthly first-aid inspection, quarterly ladder inspection, and six-month audit/drill intervals. Excel does not allow / in worksheet names, so the requested Spill/Environmental Incident sheet is named Spill Environmental Incident. Settings can be changed on Lists after unhide/unprotect.
